covers: Tuesday 17 November 2026 from 13:15 to 17:20 SAST: the end of the JSE session and the first minutes of Wall Street trade (market levels as of 16:45 SAST), with Monday's closes for reference
headline: JSE ends the day about 1.1% lower; Wall Street opens flat ahead of Nvidia's results tonight
summary: Late in the session the JSE All Share was 1.1% lower at 110,350 and the Top 40 1.1% lower at 102,466, with the rand at R16.93/$, about 1.0% weaker than Friday (LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17 Nov 2026 16:45 SAST). Shortly after the New York open the S&P 500 was at 7,406 and the Nasdaq at 24,493, both within 0.2% of Monday's close, as investors waited for Nvidia's results later today (same source). Platinum was 2.6% lower on the day at $1,436, a drag on JSE miners, while Brent firmed to $93.93; SA CPI on Wednesday and the SARB decision on Thursday remain the main local tests.

items.title: S&P 500 and Nasdaq flat at the open: 7,406 and 24,493
items.summary: At 16:45 SAST (09:45 New York) the S&P 500 was at 7,406.42 against Monday's close of 7,416.59 (-0.1%) and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,492.62 against 24,509.76 (-0.1%). Both are about 2-3% below Friday 13 November (S&P 7,561.67; Nasdaq 25,136.27) after Monday's chip-led sell-off.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17 Nov 2026 16:45 SAST; Monday close 16 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year yield 5.14%
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield was 5.141% at 16:45 SAST, up from Monday's close of 5.121% and just below Friday's 5.154%. The October FOMC minutes are due on Wednesday.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17 Nov 2026 16:45 SAST; Monday close 16 Nov 2026

items.title: JSE All Share about 1.1% lower at 110,350 late in the session
items.summary: At 16:45 SAST, shortly before the 17:00 close, the All Share was at 110,350.05 against Monday's close of 111,525.58 (-1.1%) and the Top 40 at 102,465.82 against 103,628.96 (-1.1%). That is a small recovery from the midday low of 110,164 reported in the Midday update, but the index is about 1.8% down on Friday's close of 112,388.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), 17 Nov 2026 16:45 SAST; Monday close 16 Nov 2026; Friday close 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Telkom interim: revenue +2.0% to R22.5bn, HEPS +9.3% to 334.1c, no interim dividend
items.summary: For the six months to 30 September 2026 Telkom's group revenue rose 2.0% to R22,537m and EBITDA 5.8% to R6,375m (margin 28.3%); HEPS rose 9.3% to 334.1c and free cash flow 37.8% to R998m. No interim dividend was declared, in line with its annual payout policy. Mobile service revenue grew 4% to R11.5bn and fibre homes connected rose 15.1% to 870,856, while BCX revenue fell 8.2%. On MTN, the results repeat Monday's cautionary: talks are at an early stage and there is no certainty a deal will happen. Telkom is not on the LRC coverage list.
items.source: Telkom SENS via InsidEntity, 17 Nov 2026 09:01; TechCentral, 17 Nov 2026 07:39

items.title: CPI on Wednesday, SARB on Thursday
items.summary: October CPI is due on Wednesday 18 November (September: 4.5%) and the SARB announces its decision on Thursday 19 November with the repo rate at 7.25%. A Reuters poll quoted on Monday expected October CPI at 5.1%.
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 16 Nov 2026 08:56 GMT; LRC Market Dashboard, 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Platinum -2.6% to $1,436; gold $3,867; Brent $93.93
items.summary: At 16:45 SAST: platinum $1,436.10 (Monday close $1,474.20, -2.6%); gold futures $3,867.40 (Monday $3,878.60, -0.3%); Brent $93.93 (Monday $91.71, +2.4%); copper about $13,214/t (Monday about $13,222/t). Weaker platinum weighed on PGM miners on the JSE today.

items.title: Nvidia reports tonight under interim CEO Colette Kress
items.summary: Nvidia reports quarterly results on Tuesday 17 November, its first since Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO last week. Analysts expect revenue up 91% to $108.93bn (TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026). The shares were at $158.70 in early trade on Monday, below our $262.56 fair value. Our BUY rating is unchanged; the results, not the leadership news, are the real test of it.
items.source: City AM, 16 Nov 2026 14:38 GMT; TipRanks, 16 Nov 2026

items.title: AMD fell with the chip group on Monday
items.summary: AMD was down 5.1% at Monday's open after an 8.8% fall on Friday. Our SELL rating is unchanged.
